newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil wobbles on European market after Wong data.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil wobbles on European market after Wong data.

text.p: Palm oil prices wobbled during Friday morning on the European vegetable oil market following the release of Ivan Wong's latest crop estimate.
Malaysian private forecaster Ivan Wong in his latest report projected local output during May at 784,000 tonnes, up seven percent from April.
Wong estimated stocks at 745,000 tonnes against 697,714 tonnes at end-April, while exports were projected at 635,000 tonnes against 570,067 during April.
Higher Chicago futures overnight fail to stem the fall in palm oil prices.
"The Wong report combined with the low prices at Egypt's tender this week are not good for the market," said one trader.
Crude palm oil cif Europe was offered $5 down at midday with products $2.50 to $5 lower.
In light trading olein fetched $550 for Jul and $545 for Aug/Sep a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Traders reported no activity in the remainder of the market with soft oils one to 1.50 guilders up following the sharply higher close in Chicago.
Coconut oil was mixed at $2.50 down to $2.50 up while palmkernel oil was $2.50 lower.
